newsitem.title: UK: Trading to start today in Mid Ocean stock options.
newsitem.headline: Trading to start today in Mid Ocean stock options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said on Monday it will begin trading options on the listed stocks of Mid Ocean Limited from today with the stock/option symbol MOC.
MOC will open with strike prices of 50, 55 and 60, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. Initial expiration months will be July, August and November of 1997 and February of 1998.

Mid Ocean Limited, based in Hamilton, Bermuda, through its subsidiary, Mid Ocean Reinsurance Ltd., offers property catastrophe, marine, energy, aviation, satellite and other reinsurance to insurers worldwide.
The specialist unit for the new options will be Cohen, Duffy & McGowan, Inc.
